summary: Iteration40 both-scope testing completed with public-preview-safe isolation. Backend public API guardrails pass (4 pass, 1 routed-skip). Frontend isolated regressions pass (12/12), including updated queue defaults (6 slots + visible reserve), no PIN/start_key behavior, staged warmup dedupe, released-result-only preload, grant-before-disk checks, validator-based freshness flow, and real browser-origin WebCrypto+IndexedDB checks using transpiled store.web/types.

minor.issue: Ingress serves frontend content on /health for public host, so backend JSON health is not externally routable from that origin (test skipped after 200 non-JSON).

integration_issues.issue: Intentionally not executed (no working PIN provided and policy forbids retrying previously rejected credentials).
Config-level validation passed, but actual APK/AAB size proof is NOT available in this environment (no Java/SDK/Gradle native build).

action_items: Main agent: run authenticated real-user E2E once valid working PIN/session is provided (without credential retries/guessing).
Main agent: if 20MB claim is mandatory, run real EAS/Gradle ARM64 build artifact measurement and attach signed size evidence.
Optional: expose backend health through routed /api path if external monitor needs JSON health from public host.
critical_code_review_comments: Proxy SID validation and RF catalog surfaces are healthy on public endpoint; malformed SID correctly rejected.

Asset queue/cache orchestration changes appear consistent with new requirements in isolated execution: no readiness-sheet dependency, preload gating by release status, and cache failures remain non-blocking.

Web cache crypto checks were executed in real secure-origin browser context with transpiled store.web/types (nonextractable AES-GCM key, encrypted-at-rest behavior, tamper->cache miss, owner swap/logout purge).

success_rate.backend: 80% pass (4/5; 1 expected skip due public ingress health routing)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on executed isolated/frontend-browser checks (12/12 isolated + 3 browser isolation/smoke checks)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse: `node /app/frontend/tests/iter40_frontend_isolated_tests.cjs` and backend pytest file above. Webdriver crypto evidence uses /tmp transpiled bundle generated by build_iter40_store_bundle.cjs and runs only in isolated browser origin; no live auth/session mutation performed.
rca_of_issue: No new functional regressions reproduced in tested scope. Remaining gaps are access/environment constraints: missing working auth PIN blocks live attempt/result E2E, and missing native Android toolchain blocks true APK/AAB size verification.
